authority: NONE — this instrument was never issued, enacted or in force. It is a teaching and benchmarking artifact written by researchers.
extent: US-NY by election (clause 3.3.1), but see NOTES: the same document elects Singapore's Arbitration Act (Cap. 10) at 3.2.1, which is an internal contradiction in the source, not a transcription error.

source.note: NOT LAW. A synthetic insurance policy invented as a research target. The parties are fictional ("CODEX INSURANCE LIMITED"). It is filed here because it is a body of contractual rules that has been encoded, and because the encodings beside it are evidence in a replication study; it is NOT filed here as an instrument anyone is subject to. The text encoded is the MODIFIED variant printed at arXiv:2502.17638 Appendix A.1, which differs from the original in two respects recorded in NOTES.md: the entire benefits section is absent, and the age exclusion threshold is 80 rather than 75.
